children: NeuPath Health Inc. (TSXV:NPTH), (“NeuPath” or the “Company”), operates one of Canada’s largest networks of community-based, multidisciplinary medical facilities focused on the assessment and treatment of chronic pain, musculoskeletal/back pain, sports medicine and other pain-related medical services, today announced that it will host its annual Physician Forum from September 25 to 27, 2026, at Fairmont Le Château Montebello in Montebello, Québec.

Now in its third year, NeuPath’s annual Physician Forum has grown in participation each year and sold out for this year. This event will welcome clinicians from its network and prospective physician partners. Supported by industry sponsors, the event provides an opportunity to exchange clinical insights and strengthen connections across the broader healthcare community.

“The Physician Forum brings our clinical community together to share experiences and explore advances in chronic and musculoskeletal pain management,” said Stephen Lemieux, Chief Executive Officer of NeuPath. “It is an opportunity to strengthen relationships within our growing network, connect with new physician colleagues and share practical knowledge that supports patient care. We thank our speakers and sponsors for supporting this year’s program.”

This year’s program will feature expert-led presentations and practical sessions covering complex regional pain syndrome, myoActivation, cervicogenic and migraine headaches, artificial intelligence, and psychotherapeutic approaches to chronic pain.
Featured speakers include:
Dr. Ryan Budwany,

a triple board-certified interventional spine and pain physician whose work focuses on minimally invasive interventions, emerging technologies and responsible integration of artificial intelligence. He serves as Chief Medical Officer of PainHealth.
Dr. Pradeep Chopra,

Director of the Center for Complex Conditions and Assistant Professor at Brown Medical School, whose work focuses on complex chronic pain and associated conditions. Dr. Chopra completed training in anesthesia, critical care and pain medicine at Harvard.
Dr. Gary Shapero,
a family physician and board-certified pain practitioner specializing in headache, neck and facial pain, and a Lecturer in the University of Toronto’s Department of Family and Community Medicine.
Dr. Greg Siren,

a family physician focused on chronic pain and mobility impairment and the developer of myoActivation, a non-pharmaceutical approach to assessing and treating pain. He has led more than 50 myoActivation workshops and serves as Director of the Anatomic Medicine Foundation.
Dr. Ed Weiss,
a Kingston-based family physician with training in psychotherapeutic approaches to neuroplastic pain treatment.
To learn more about NeuPath’s annual Physician Forum, including the full program and speaker details, please view the event brochure
About NeuPath Health Inc.

NeuPath operates one of Canada’s largest networks of community-based, multidisciplinary medical facilities focused on the assessment and treatment of chronic pain, musculoskeletal/back pain, sports medicine and other pain-related medical services. NeuPath provides improved access to care and outcomes for patients by leveraging best-in-class treatments and delivering patient-centered multidisciplinary care. Working within Canada’s publicly funded healthcare system, NeuPath delivers insured medical services to help extend the appropriate care from hospitals into the community, which are complemented by select non-insured procedures to provide a comprehensive and coordinated treatment for patients.
